notes.text: CCNL FISM signed 28/05/2025 (sede ASI). Validity 01/09/2023-31/08/2027. Economic accord for 2026-2027 signed 07/07/2026.
CONGLOBATED (Art. 43): indennita di contingenza maturata al 30/11/1991 inglobata nella retribuzione tabellare (Art. 42 lett. B). No separate contingenza column.
SALARY TABLE (Art. 42 lett. B): 5 tranches — 01/09/2023, 01/06/2025, 01/09/2025 from main CCNL PDF; 01/09/2026, 01/09/2027 from 2026-2027 economic accord.
HOURLY DIVISOR (Art. 51): 160 h/month for 37h/week. Divisors for 35h=152, 32h=139 also stated.
ADDITIONAL MONTHS (Art. 49): tredicesima only, paid by 20 December.

SENIORITY (Arts. 40, 44-46): the scatti were frozen at 31/12/2015 and consolidated by the CCNL 2016-2018; those amounts and the salario di anzianità of the earlier renewals are the worker's own (the caller states them as individual elements). The salario di anzianità of Art. 46 from 1 September 2025 (15 EUR levels I-IV, 20 EUR levels V-VIII, 13 payments, two years of uninterrupted service on that day) is a fixed allowance of every level (in_service_on 2023-09-01). Approximated: an interruption of the service before 1 September 2025 is not read, and the amount follows the level of the run instead of the level held on 1 September 2025.

limitation.remediation: State the level held and whether the service was uninterrupted on 1 September 2025.

notes.text: APPRENTICESHIP: no apprenticeship clause found in main CCNL text. Sector primarily employs teachers on permanent contracts. Modelled as single percentage period at 100% (identity transform) for all levels; correct for permanent staff.

limitation.remediation: Source the apprenticeship clause and replace the 100% identity track.

notes.text: SICKNESS (Art. 69): the CCNL integrates up to 100% of the net monthly pay ('retribuzione mensile netta') without saying how the net pay is computed. The engine grosses up the INPS indemnity by the worker's INPS rate (the 'lordizzazione' of payroll practice, Ordine dei Consulenti del Lavoro di Salerno) and tops it up to the measure of the gross daily quota; IRPEF is left out, as it falls on both. Day bands, carenza by event, the yearly comporto and the exclusion of apprentices are modelled.

limitation.remediation: Find a source (an interpretation of the parties, an INPS or Ministry text) that defines the net daily pay of Art. 69, align the computation, then resolve this limitation.

notes.text: APPRENTICE SENIORITY: the aumenti periodici are abolished for every worker since the CCNL 2016-2018 (Art. 44, p. 34 of the CCNL 2024-2027), so an apprentice matures none (seniority_increments.apprentice_amount 0.00).

reviews.scope: The accrual rule of the tredicesima (fractions of a month) against the full CCNL text.
findings: Art. 49 Tredicesima mensilità (p. 37): "Le frazioni di mese vengono prese in considerazione solo se superiori a 15 giorni ed in tal caso equiparate ad un mese intero.". Match: more_than 15.

reviews.scope: Monthly values on scanned pages, each read twice from the page image by two independent sessions of another model, the second without being told the expected value.
findings: 40 values read identically by both readings and equal to the file.

reviews.scope: Art. 40, 44, 46 of the CCNL FISM of 28 May 2025 (PDF pp. 32-36, page images) and the economic agreement 2026-2027 (p. 2) for amendments.
findings: Art. 46: from 1 September 2025, 15 EUR (levels I-IV) or 20 EUR (V-VIII) a month for 13 payments to the staff with two years of uninterrupted service with the Ente on that day, added to the salario di anzianità of earlier renewals.
The agreement of 7 July 2026 does not amend art. 46.

provenance.note: Number of monthly payments read from the contract file; no clause is cited for it.

location.quote: Dal 1° settembre 2025 è corrisposto mensilmente, per tredici mensilità, a titolo di "salario di anzianità", l'importo di cui sotto a tutto il personale che a quella data abbia maturato 2 anni di servizio ininterrotto presso lo stesso Ente. Tale importo si aggiunge a quanto già maturato come salario di anzianità secondo previsione dei rinnovi contrattuali precedenti. Di seguito si riporta l'importo del salario di anzianità in base al livello di inquadramento alla data del 1° settembre 2025: - 15,00 € per i livelli I-II-III-IV - 20,00 € per i livelli V-VI-VII-VIII

provenance.transformation: EUR 20.00 a month on 13 payments from 1 September 2025 to the worker in service with the Ente since 1 September 2023 at the latest (two years of service on 1 September 2025: in_service_on), on the level of the run. Approximated: 'ininterrotto' is read from the start of the employment period; the amount follows the level of the run, where the text fixes the level held on 1 September 2025. Paid in full to an apprentice too ('a tutto il personale').

location.section: Art. 69 a) e b)
location.quote: l'ente corrisponderà al lavoratore una integrazione tale da consentire al medesimo di percepire durante il periodo di malattia o infortunio il 100% della retribuzione mensile netta per un massimo di 180 giorni nell’anno solare.

provenance.transformation: Art. 69 a): the integration reaches 100% of the net monthly pay for at most 180 sick days in the calendar year, every episode of the year counted; stored as the 180 days of comporto_calendar_year, past which the CCNL integrates nothing. The comporto of b) (180 continuous days, 365 in three calendar years) keeps the job and does not change the pay. The text is a scan: the quote is from an OCR of the signed PDF, read on 2026-10-30.
